Name: Gideon
Summary: Gideon was an unlikely judge whom God called a mighty warrior while he hid from Midianite raiders. God reduced his army to three hundred men so Israel would know the victory was the Lord's.
KeyStory: With torches, jars, and trumpets, Gideon's three hundred men surrounded the Midianite camp at night, and God threw the enemy into confusion.
LifeLesson: God called Gideon mighty while Gideon felt weakest — God names us by what He will make us, not by what we feel. Your small army is enough when God fights for you.
